baselineDisplay.title: No Wrong Numbers
baselineDisplay.question: What does 'No wrong numbers' mean?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: “没有错误的数字”是什么意思？
baselineDisplay.text:
What does 'No wrong numbers' mean?

Mr.James Scott has a garage in Silbury and now he has just bought another garage in Pinhurst.
Pinhurst is only five miles from Silbury, but Mr. Scott cannot get a telephone for his new garage, so he has just bought twelve pigeons.
Yesterday, a pigeon carried the first message from Pinhurst to Silbury.
The bird covered the distance in three minutes.
Up to now,
Mr.Scott has sent a great many requests for spare parts and other urgent messages from one garage to the other.
In this way, he has begun his own private 'telephone' service.

Yesterday, a pigeon carried the first message from Pinhurst to Silbury.

Up to now,
Mr.Scott has sent a great many requests for spare parts and other urgent messages from one garage to the other.
In this way, he has begun his own private 'telephone' service.
baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
詹姆斯·斯科特先生在塞尔伯里（Silbury）有一间车库。现在他又在 Pinhurst 买了一个车库。
平赫斯特（Pinhurst）距离西尔伯里（Silbury）只有五英里。但是斯科特先生无法为他的新车库配备一部电话。所以他刚刚买了十二只鸽子。
昨天，一只鸽子把第一封信从平赫斯特送到了塞尔伯里。
这只鸽子花了三分钟飞完了这段路程。
到目前为止，
斯科特先生已经从一个车库向另一个车库发送了大量索取备件的请求以及其他紧急信息。
通过这种方式，他开始了自己的私人“电话”服务。

corrections.evidence: 00:10.38提问引用本课标题No wrong numbers，本课00:03.00中译标题已明确无错号之虞，背景是电话服务而非抽象数字。
00:25.60的Silbury与00:15.79、00:38.96是同一地点；同课首尾均作塞尔伯里，统一中间一次音译。

notes: 通读信鸽传讯故事，核对两地五英里、十二只鸽子、三分钟送信及备件请求；提问中错号误译成数字，按本课中译标题恢复；Silbury两种音译按同课首尾统一。补齐Mr.与姓名间空格，不拆跨条Up to now续句。
